_README: CENTRAL HOLIDAY ADJUSTMENTS for the Normandy Mead collection calendar.
This is the ONE file to edit when the council shifts collections for bank
holidays. Every household's app re-reads it, and the published calendar
feeds in /calendar are rebuilt automatically, so a single commit here
updates everyone. No app rebuild, no reinstall.
HOW TO EDIT
1. Open this file on GitHub and click the pencil icon.
2. Add an entry to "adjustments" for each affected collection.
3. Commit. A GitHub Action rebuilds the calendar feeds within a minute.
ENTRY FORMAT - 'scheduled' is the normal date the app would have shown;
it is the key, so use the regular schedule's date, not the new one.
Moved to a different day:
{ "scheduled": "2026-12-24", "actual": "2026-12-23", "reason": "Christmas Eve" }
Cancelled with no replacement:
{ "scheduled": "2027-01-01", "cancelled": true, "reason": "New Year's Day" }
Glass rather than waste - add "stream": "glass":
{ "scheduled": "2026-12-31", "actual": "2027-01-02", "stream": "glass", "reason": "New Year" }
Fields: scheduled (required), actual, cancelled, stream, type, reason.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
'stream' is "waste" (default) or "glass". IMPORTANT: if waste and glass
fall on the same day and BOTH move, you need TWO entries - one per stream.
'type' ("general"/"recycling"/"glass") is a rare override for when the
council swaps which bin goes out; normally omit it.
IMPORTANT: adjusting a date does NOT change the alternation. The app works
out which bin is due from the regular schedule, then moves that collection.
So a Christmas shift will not knock the general/recycling cycle out of step.
Entries in the past are harmless. Bump 'updated' when you change anything.
